evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, schema_problem indexes _SCHEMA_TYPES for every declared type name. Since _SCHEMA_TYPES omits JSON Schema's "number", a receipt schema using type: "number" raises KeyError instead of returning the intended first-violation diagnostic. This contradicts the function's stated fail-closed/no-raising behavior and can abort receipt validation rather than report the unsupported schema type.
